title: satureja caroliniana
intro: Satureja caroliniana, commonly known as Carolina savory, is a perennial herb native to the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function, making it a popular choice for treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. The health benefits of Satureja caroliniana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carnosic acid, carnosol, and ursolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
